language.label: Language
language.description: System reads the language the machine is set to, and falls back to English.

diagnostics.label: Application log
diagnostics.description: Records the URL without its query, the error code and the connection state. Never headers, tokens or message bodies, so the file can be attached to an issue as it is.

startup.label: On startup
startup.description: The welcome window is where a workspace is chosen, created and duplicated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: System follows the light or dark mode of the desktop.

editorFontSize.label: Editor font size
editorFontSize.description: Applies to the composer, the documentation and the log detail.

activityLimit.label: Maximum messages per connection
activityLimit.description: Past it, the oldest are dropped. The traffic counter is not reset.

activityByteLimit.label: Maximum log memory
activityByteLimit.description: Ceiling for the bodies of the messages kept. Whichever limit is reached first wins.
